item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines exactly two `dspy.Predict` fields, and `student.predictors()` enumerates predictor instances, so compile counts two predictor slots."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Both `self.first.lm` and `self.second.lm` are assigned the same `DummyLM` instance, isolating predictor-count vs model-count behavior."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Sets `multitask=False`, which makes `data_pred_ind = pred_ind` and thus creates distinct training keys per predictor instead of merging by LM."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Calls `optimizer.compile(student, trainset=trainset)` with `num_threads=1`; with two predictor-specific jobs, the `len(key_to_data) > num_threads` check raises `ValueError`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"The `ValueError` is the expected path, and the code prints the message and asserts it mentions `num_threads` and `fine-tuning jobs`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
